name: agent-cli-proxy
description: Self-hosted AI API proxy with per-tool usage monitoring, account attribution, and cost tracking for OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
author: Agent CLI Proxy contributors

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/cli.ts --target=bun --outdir=./dist && rm -rf dist/migrations && cp -R src/storage/migrations dist/migrations && bun run scripts/post-build.ts
scripts.release-check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && (bunx publint . || bun run scripts/release-fallback-check.ts)
scripts.test:e2e:mock: MOCK_CLI_PROXY=1 CLI_PROXY_API_URL=http://localhost:18317 bun test tests/e2e/admin-auth.test.ts && MOCK_CLI_PROXY=1 CLI_PROXY_API_URL=http://localhost:18317 bun test tests/e2e/body-size-limit.test.ts && MOCK_CLI_PROXY=1 CLI_PROXY_API_URL=http://localhost:18317 bun test tests/e2e/ready.test.ts && MOCK_CLI_PROXY=1 CLI_PROXY_API_URL=http://localhost:18317 bun test tests/e2e/proxy.test.ts && MOCK_CLI_PROXY=1 CLI_PROXY_API_URL=http://localhost:18317 bun test tests/e2e/transforms.test.ts
